svg.aria-label: For each format and way of calling the card, the number of elements a call needs before the tile beats the fastest real software, for multiply, fused multiply-add and add on two machines: from 571 elements to never.
svg.title: For each format and way of calling the card, the number of elements a call needs before the tile beats the fastest real software, for multiply, fused multiply-add and add on two machines: from 571 elements to never.
svg.text: How many elements a call needs before the card pays
Each mark is the size of call, in elements, from which the tile's time per element stays under the fastest real
software's, found between the two measured sizes on a log-log line. Rows are the format and how the card is called;
the cross at the right is a tile that never wins in the measured range.
